main_report.qualify_current_discovery_descriptions: At beabed1f7, R5-F1's three original inputs pass. Discovery still infers a parent common directory for gitfiles naming worktrees/<id> when commondir is absent or CR/LF-only, which can omit a valid own store (R6-F1). Git also accepts pointers padded with trailing CR/LF beyond discovery's 64 KiB cap; discovery silently drops that read error (R6-F2). Both cases permit retirement of a running borrower's storage without incomplete evidence. The required fail-closed guarantee and the existing swap-back, timestamp and later-dependency observation bounds are unchanged.
